note: THE CONVERGENCE BASELINE. Frozen figures from the served build, measured against a checklist written before the pass was run. The auditor's job is defending these: any regression is a RED that outranks other work. A number here is not a target to tune toward — it is a state that was reached and understood, and a DEPARTURE in either direction is the signal.
question: what does the certified positivity work establish

battery.correction: THE ZERO WAS TRUE AND IT WAS NOT THE WHOLE TRUTH. The baseline pass reported 0 findings over 10 probes against the NINE checks that existed when it ran. Two checks were then added to defend the baseline — discrimination band, and composition-carrying — and the SAME BUILD immediately reported 5. Nothing regressed: a property that was always there became visible. The figure is corrected here rather than in a later commit, because a baseline claiming zero while the battery reports five is a baseline nobody can defend.
battery.the_open_item: ATTACHMENT IS UNSTABLE ACROSS QUESTIONS on this build. Four probes get essentially nothing from a 59-object region and one gets essentially all of it, while the frozen fixture sits at 0.576 — a healthy middle. The fixture met the convergence target and the battery says the fixture is not representative. That is the top open item, and it is the same instability the roster clause exposed rather than caused: the clause moved attachment to a pole, and the poles were already reachable without it.

bands.why: A fraction at or above the high bound is the engine's own INDISCRIMINATE threshold — the medium drew an arrow to essentially everything, so the attachment carries no information about which claims the input bears on. At or below the low bound the field did not respond at all. Column F sat at 1.00 and read as a boundary crossing; the local arm of the same bisect sat at 0.00. Both poles are degeneracies and neither is a better answer than the middle.

composition_rule: A VIOLATION COUNT IS NEVER RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COMPOSITION. 60 with this composition is a understood state; 4 at discrimination 1.00 was a machine that had stopped discriminating rather than one that had stopped erring.

known_costs.welded_enumeration: 13 of the 31 welds are enumeration-shaped, the recorded cost of withdrawing the roster clause after two razor-legal wordings both degenerated. See seed/INVENTORY.md row 530 and fixture column F.
known_costs.uncontested: The (!) mark reaches turn 1's sheet and both prompts state the rule, so these are compliable-and-uncomplied — convictions, not traps.

restamp.why: Row 532 fixed: the checker's contested set is now the shown contested set.
restamp.what_moved: ONE conviction, and that number understates the change entirely. The fix was SYMMETRIC: three objects the checker held hot without the wire marking them stopped convicting (the trap), and three the wire marked without the checker enforcing started convicting (the useless mark). 28 became 27 because six convictions were replaced by five, not because six were removed.
restamp.what_actually_changed: EVERY REMAINING CONVICTION IS COMPLIABLE. Measured on the fixed build, three draws, byte-identical: 19 objects marked (!) on the wire, 19 held hot by the checker, and the two sets are IDENTICAL — hot-not-marked is empty and marked-not-hot is empty. Before the fix they differed by three in each direction. The count barely moved and its meaning changed completely, which is the composition rule arriving one level deeper: a composition can be stable while the thing it is composed of stops being honest.
